integrity: All finite counts derive from complete exact dual enumeration, syndrome-collision support census and independent polynomial/affine checks. Self-review only; no independently certified or externally validated scientific result.
scientific_limitations: One fixed nonprimitive binary BCH code of length 73; does not determine the full weight enumerator or extend to other BCH lengths. Previously known A_6=876 and twelve cyclic orbits are not claimed novel. Historical priority under alternative descriptions remains uncertain.
title: Affine support geometry and cyclic generation in the length-73 BCH code
